name: ecwid-mcp
description: Ecwid by Lightspeed (ecommerce channels): me, create_listing, update_listing, end_listing, set_inven

platform_mcp_ecwid_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ECWID_TOKEN
platform_mcp_ecwid_token.description: Secret token of a custom app (Ecwid admin > Apps > Develop Apps > app Details; scopes read_catalog, create_catalog, update_catalog, read_orders, update_orders); non-expiring, sent as `Authorization: Bearer secret_...`.

platform_mcp_ecwid_store_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ECWID_STORE_ID
platform_mcp_ecwid_store_id.description: Ecwid store id (shown in the admin footer / URL); every call goes to https://app.ecwid.com/api/v3/{store_id}/...

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/v3/{storeId}/profile returns the store profile {generalInfo{storeId, storeUrl}, account{accountName, accountEmail}, settings{storeName}, formatsAndUnits{currency}, ...}.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: POST /api/v3/{storeId}/products {name, sku, price (required by Ecwid), quantity, description} (scope create_catalog) returns {id}. `currency` is the store's (formatsAndUnits), and images go through a separate upload endpoint, so `currency`/`image_urls` are ignored.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/products/{productId} with the given fields (name, price, description, quantity); returns {updateCount}.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/products/{productId} {enabled: false} takes the product off the storefront (documented boolean; reversible with enabled=true) and returns {updateCount}. DELETE /products/{id} (permanent) is not used.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/products/{productId} {quantity} sets the absolute stock (PUT .../products/{id}/inventory takes a quantityDelta instead). `listing_id` (product id) is required; `sku` alone is not accepted (lookup by sku is a second call).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /api/v3/{storeId}/orders?offset&limit(max 100)&createdFrom(UNIX timestamp or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')&fulfillmentStatus(AWAITING_PROCESSING|PROCESSING|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|...). Returns {total, count, offset, limit, items[{id, orderNumber, total, paymentStatus, fulfillmentStatus, createDate, trackingNumber}]}; `status` is the fulfillmentStatus and there is no per-order currency field.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: PUT /api/v3/{storeId}/orders/{orderId} {fulfillmentStatus: SHIPPED, trackingNumber, shippingOption: {shippingCarrierName}} (scope update_orders) returns {updateCount}.
